claim: The input structure contains chains A and D with 108 and 87 residues, respectively.
A measurable A-D interface exists with residue contact pairs within 5.5 and 8 Å.
SKEMPI contains barnase-barstar affinity-changing mutations that can be mapped onto 1BRS_A_D.
Simple structural contact/electrostatic features have quantifiable agreement with experimental ΔΔG.
Feature contributions are interpretable at residue/contact level.
